newsitem.title: USA: Esterline sells unit to Thermo unit.
newsitem.headline: Esterline sells unit to Thermo unit.

text.p: Esterline Technologies Corp said Friday it has sold its Angus Electronics unit to Westronics Inc, a unit of Thermo Instrument Systems Inc.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed, the company said.

The sale of Angus, a producer of electronic data recording equipment, "will have no material effect on Esterline's financial position, sales or earnings," Esterline chief executive officer Wendell P. Hurlbut said in a written statement.
"It is another step to increase our emphasis on our core business," Hurlbut said.
Esterline manufactures products for the aircraft, aerospace and defense industries, the company said.
Westronics is a supplier of data recording equipment, Esterline said.
